"""保存本轮共享只读审阅的全部检查原始输出及返回码。"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round7-shared-checks'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
commands = [
    ['rustc', '--version'], [sys.executable, '--version'], ['cargo', 'fetch', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'],
    ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'],
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
]
rows = []
for index, command in enumerate(commands, 1):
    if command[0] in {'cargo', 'rustc', 'git'}:
        command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    path = OUT / f'command-{index:02}.log'
    path.write_bytes(result.stdout)
    row = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - start,
           'log': path.name, 'bytes': len(result.stdout), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest()}
    rows.append(row)
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()
report = {'checked_head': head, 'source_implementation': 'ce2c16e8f53da9913f2624675c7807d07c044877',
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': rows}
(OUT / 'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
raise SystemExit(0 if all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in rows) else 1)

"""保存PR1的完整Git差异目录、源码身份和非破坏性方向兼容检查。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round7-pr1-review'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
MAIN = 'a564fd47b0f054ff360592af3ccb8d744021160f'
SHARED = 'c48584d411eceb82dcc6b8a30df9a33d9e995762'


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root)


head = git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
assert git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'origin/main').decode().strip() == MAIN
patch = git(ROOT, 'diff', '--full-index', '--binary', MAIN, SHARED)
(OUT / 'main-to-round6-shared.patch').write_bytes(patch)
paths = git(ROOT, 'diff', '--name-status', MAIN, SHARED).decode('utf-8').splitlines()
listing = git(ROOT, 'ls-tree', '-r', SHARED).decode('utf-8').splitlines()
objects = {row.split('\t', 1)[1]: row.split()[2] for row in listing}
changes = []
for row in paths:
    status, name = row.split('\t', 1)
    data = git(ROOT, 'show', SHARED + ':' + name)
    changes.append({'status': status, 'path': name, 'git_blob_sha1': objects[name],
                    'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
critical = ['crates/cloudleaf-input/src/lib.rs', 'crates/cloudleaf-types/src/lib.rs',
            'scripts/check_workspace.py', 'config/audits/core.json', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock',
            'LICENSE', 'crates/cloudleaf-input/tests/platform_contract_v2.rs',
            'crates/cloudleaf-input/tests/round6_shared_review.rs']
sources = {name: {'git_blob_sha1': git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', head + ':' + name).decode().strip(),
                  'sha256': hashlib.sha256(git(ROOT, 'show', head + ':' + name)).hexdigest()} for name in critical}
assert not git(ROOT, 'diff', '--name-only', SHARED, head, '--', 'crates', 'scripts', 'tests', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'config')
directions = []
for name in ['cl007-windows', 'cl008-search', 'cl009-data']:
    work = Path.home() / '.codex/worktrees' / name / 'Cloudleaf'
    direction = git(work, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
    base = git(ROOT, 'merge-base', head, direction).decode().strip()
    preview = subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-tree', '--write-tree', '--messages', head, direction], cwd=ROOT,
                             stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    shared_blobs = {path: git(work, 'rev-parse', direction + ':' + path).decode().strip()
                    for path in critical[:2]}
    assert all(shared_blobs[path] == sources[path]['git_blob_sha1'] for path in critical[:2])
    directions.append({'worktree': str(work), 'head': direction, 'merge_base': base, 'shared_core_blobs': shared_blobs,
                       'base_to_direction_name_status': git(ROOT, 'diff', '--name-status', base, direction).decode('utf-8'),
                       'shared_to_direction_name_status': git(ROOT, 'diff', '--name-status', head, direction).decode('utf-8'),
                       'preview_exit': preview.returncode, 'preview_stdout': preview.stdout.decode('utf-8'),
                       'preview_stderr': preview.stderr.decode('utf-8')})
report = {'main_sha': MAIN, 'reviewed_round6_shared_sha': SHARED, 'checked_shared_head': head,
          'scope': 'Complete Git path inventory and patch identity; executable/API diff reviewed directly; generated histories are hashed, not independently language-validated',
          'full_patch_bytes': len(patch), 'full_patch_sha256': hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
          'changes': changes, 'critical_source_identities': sources, 'directions': directions,
          'new_shared_production_changes': [], 'preview_is_integration_acceptance': False}
(OUT / 'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'changed_files': len(changes), 'patch_bytes': len(patch), 'directions': [
    {'head': d['head'], 'base': d['merge_base'], 'preview_exit': d['preview_exit']} for d in directions]}))

"""只向本轮新目录归档审阅原件、展示件、数据和宿主身份。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reviews/pr1-round7-evidence'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--', str(OUT)], cwd=ROOT), '不覆盖已提交证据'


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save(name, data):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


originals = {}
checks = ROOT / '.local/round7-shared-checks'
for path in sorted(checks.iterdir()):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    originals[path.name] = {'original_path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')}
    if path.suffix == '.log':
        display = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()).rstrip()
        (OUT / (path.stem + '.txt')).write_text(display + ('\n' if display else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    else:
        save(path.name, json.loads(raw))
save('originals.json', {'encoding': 'UTF-8; utf8.encode recovers original byte sequence without newline translation', 'files': originals})
save('review.json', json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round7-pr1-review/review.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
save('baseline-ci.json', json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round7-baseline-ci.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
save('peer-review.json', json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round7-peer-review.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
save('harness-preparation-failures.json', json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round7-shared-harness-failures.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
validation = json.loads((checks / 'validation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(validation['checks']) == 12 and all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in validation['checks'])
exe = ROOT / 'target/release/cloudleaf-cli.exe'
save('identity.json', {'checked_head': validation['checked_head'], 'source_implementation': validation['source_implementation'],
                      'release_cli_path': str(exe), 'release_cli_bytes': exe.stat().st_size, 'release_cli_sha256': sha(exe.read_bytes()),
                      'resources': {name: sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) for name in [
                          'data/dictionaries/prototype.tsv', 'tests/fixtures/input-v1.tsv', 'tests/evaluation/algorithm-v1.tsv']},
                      'runtime_or_tsf_measurement_performed': False,
                      'original_encoding': 'UTF-8; original logs stored separately from LF display copies'})
sources = []
for name in ['run_round7_shared.py', 'review_round7_pr1.py', 'publish_round7_shared.py', 'audit_round7_preservation.py']:
    data = (ROOT / '.local' / name).read_bytes()
    sources.append({'name': name, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha(data), 'utf8': data.decode('utf-8')})
save('runners.json', {'sources': sources, 'scope': 'Original local paths; verify matching inputs before adapting paths'})
manifest = {p.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name != 'checksums.json'}
save('checksums.json', {'scope': 'Git-normalized LF publication bytes; original raw bytes separately preserved', 'sha256': manifest})
print(json.dumps({'originals': len(originals), 'published_files': len(manifest), 'validated_commands': len(validation['checks'])}))

"""核对R6起点历史、旧测试和共享核心边界，不修改方向内容。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
STARTS = {
    ROOT: 'c48584d411eceb82dcc6b8a30df9a33d9e995762',
    Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl007-windows\Cloudleaf'): 'caefb7f2ac7c8584249c05359fcb174f87640886',
    Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl008-search\Cloudleaf'): '417dad662bfebedf3238f909476240427cc9100b',
    Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl009-data\Cloudleaf'): '52619a963070cd74c53d0b8d76fc40bf5b7a8327',
}


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root)


results = []
for root, start in STARTS.items():
    reports = git(root, 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', start, 'docs/reports').decode().splitlines()
    changed = git(root, 'diff', '--name-only', start, '--', *reports).decode().splitlines()
    assert not changed, (str(root), changed)
    deleted = git(root, 'diff', '--diff-filter=D', '--name-only', start, '--', 'crates', 'tests', 'adapters').decode().splitlines()
    assert not deleted, (str(root), deleted)
    resources = {}
    for name in ['data/dictionaries/prototype.tsv', 'tests/fixtures/input-v1.tsv', 'tests/evaluation/algorithm-v1.tsv']:
        path = root / name
        assert git(root, 'hash-object', '--path=' + name, str(path)).strip() == git(root, 'rev-parse', start + ':' + name).strip()
        resources[name] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    core = git(root, 'diff', '--name-only', start, '--', 'crates/cloudleaf-input', 'crates/cloudleaf-types',
               'crates/cloudleaf-pinyin', 'crates/cloudleaf-dictionary', 'crates/cloudleaf-candidate', 'apps/cloudleaf-cli').decode().splitlines()
    assert not core, (str(root), core)
    results.append({'root': str(root), 'baseline_sha': start, 'head': git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip(),
                    'historical_reports_checked': len(reports), 'historical_reports_changed': changed,
                    'old_test_files_deleted': deleted, 'shared_core_changes': core, 'protected_resource_sha256': resources})
print(json.dumps({'verified': True, 'scope': 'Git path preservation; not a formal language, platform or integration acceptance',
                  'directions': results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
